shared_elements: human figure with raised arm holding an object
justification: The only real correspondence is that both include a human figure with an arm raised holding an object, a near-universal motif; A's tiny stick-like figures with upraised arms are matched loosely by B's single figure brandishing a club. Otherwise A is a dense schematic scatter of boats with crew-strokes, cattle in profile and miniature stick people spread over a whole surface, while B is one large, anatomically modelled, tattooed standing figure with headdress and sash — no shared arrangement, scale relations or drawing conventions.
